rationale: Genome-wide GeCKOv2 knockout screen in MOLM-13 AML cells treated for 3 days with a sublethal dose of the NAMPT inhibitor KPT-9274 or DMSO, 7 days after library infection (Zhang et al. 2021). GEO deposits only a MAGeCK count_normalized table; prepare.R recovers the integer reads (100% of each column integer-valued) and keeps the 1,000 non-targeting controls. One library per condition (DMSO.R1, KPT9274.R1), so run_barcs.R uses the no-replicate path and the calls are screening-level. The paper's question: which knockouts sensitize cells to KPT-9274 (synthetic lethal), i.e. guides depleted in KPT-9274 relative to DMSO. The authors ran MAGeCK VISPR (negatively selected genes, Table 1) and prioritized HDAC8 and SIRT6 for validation. Day 0 is the pre-treatment reference and is not part of the drug contrast.
